name: Jethro
description: Midianite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law and led it to the backside of the desert, to Horeb the mountain of God; and the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush, and the bush was not consumed.

note.label: Exodus 3: The Angel in the Burning Bush

points: Moses returned to Jethro his father in law and asked leave, and Jethro said, Go in peace. The LORD said, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life; the Pharaoh of chapter 2 had died.

note.label: Exodus 4: The Three Signs and the Covenant of Circumcision

points: Jethro the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard all that God had done for Moses and for Israel, and came to Moses in the wilderness with Zipporah and her two sons, Gershom and Eliezer.
Jethro is the same man called Reuel in Exodus 2: the priest of Midian whose seven daughters Moses helped at the well, and who gave Moses Zipporah his daughter. Reuel and Jethro are one person.

note.label: Exodus 18: Jethro's Counsel and Righteous Leadership

points: Moses said unto Hobab the son of Raguel the Midianite, his kinsman by marriage, we are journeying unto the place of which the Lord said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good. Hobab answered that he would depart to his own land and to his kindred, to go back to his people.

note.label: Numbers 10: The Silver Trumpets and the Order of the Journeys
